name: CapCut Character Mask Shadow Glow
use_when: A character, object, eye, hair edge, weapon, or body part needs isolated glow, shadow, flicker, or emphasis.
The edit style is high-energy, anime-inspired, music-led, or intentionally stylized.
A whole-frame effect would distract from the subject or reduce action clarity.
avoid_when: The cutout or mask edge is too rough for the project tone.
The effect hides the action pose, face, expression, or impact frame.
The source asset, character footage, or cutout rights are not usable for the intended release.

timeline_pattern.pattern: base_clip -> duplicate_clip_or_screenshot_cutout -> remove_background_or_mask_subject -> shadow_or_glow_layer -> flicker_graph -> preview_edges
timeline_pattern.cutout_rule: Use a clean screenshot cutout, duplicate layer, background removal, or quick brush before adding style effects.
timeline_pattern.mask_rule: Apply the effect only to the subject or body part that needs emphasis.
timeline_pattern.edge_rule: Review the full affected range because rough masks become obvious during motion and flicker.

motion.rule: Flicker and glow should pulse with the edit rhythm while the subject remains readable.

keyframe_values.flicker_burst: Use short opacity or intensity bursts around the impact frame; avoid constant flicker across the whole clip.
keyframe_values.shadow_offset: Keep shadow offset subtle enough to read as depth rather than a second distracting subject.
keyframe_values.hold: Hold the clean hero pose long enough after the glow lands for the viewer to register the subject.

sound.rule: Pair glow, flicker, or shadow reveals with a small hit, zap, or texture only if it supports the visible effect and stays below music/dialogue.

captions.rule: Do not place captions over the isolated glow or shadow if that body part is the focus of the beat.

color.rule: Glow color should support the character or scene palette and should not crush edge detail or create compression dirt.

implementation.ffmpeg: Use alpha mattes or prepared PNG cutouts, overlay duplicated layers, apply glow/blur/color filters to the isolated layer, and render edge-check stills.
implementation.remotion: Layer the base clip, a masked subject asset, shadow/glow styles, and opacity/intensity keyframes; store maskReviewFrames and captionCollision zones.
implementation.blender: Use masked planes or compositor mattes with glow, color, and shadow layers for stylized 2D character effects.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Duplicate the clip or import a prepared cutout, use Mask or Remove Background/quick brush, add shadow/glow/flicker effects, and preview mask edges at full speed.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Duplicate the clip, use opacity masks or a prepared alpha cutout, add VR Glow/blur/drop shadow or equivalent effects, and keyframe opacity/intensity for flicker.

common_mistakes: Applying glow to the whole frame when only the character detail needs emphasis.
Leaving rough cutout edges visible during motion.
Making flicker constant instead of tied to a beat or impact.
Letting glow cover captions, action, or facial detail.
Using unlicensed or unclear source footage in a publishable edit.
qc: Are the mask edges clean across the full affected range?
Does the glow or shadow emphasize the intended subject part only?
Can the viewer still read the action pose after the effect?
Do captions avoid the emphasized body part or character edge?
Are source rights and attribution ready for any real project?
